role: TGA packages express Trust Graph-derived governance patterns using TSMM v0.21 runtime governance semantics while preserving essay provenance as a repository-specific extension.

maps.notes: TGA graph.json files are TSMM-native interpretations of essay-derived governance problems.
TGA extends the TSMM receipt core with sourceEssays and optional signature material.
TGA packages identify the actor, effect, boundary, authority basis, policy references, evidence references, status or revocation check, decision, and receipt expectation before effect admission.
TGA controls are interpreted as package-local projections of TSMM authority origin, delegation edge, scope, status, and revocation semantics.
TGA examples distinguish lifecycle state, decision outcome, and effect admission rather than collapsing them into a single success flag.
Essay provenance explains design motivation and must not be confused with runtime evidence.
Values minimal, operational, assured, and agentic are posture labels, not TIS assurance levels.

compatibleWith: trust-infrastructure-schemas v0.10.0 via TSMM/TIS runtime assurance projection
